use_case_summary: Primary: in-app conversational support (chat) for mid-market customers + content personalization via reranking. Secondary: similarity embeddings for search and recommendations. Peak: expected 200k tokens/day initially, ramp to 1M over 12 months. Latency targets: chat p95 <150ms for EU primary region, <200ms for routed secondary region. Throughput: sustained 50 qps for embeddings batch jobs during working hours. Cost sensitivity: high for token-heavy flows - looking for quantization/optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost.
